findings.summary: Feature Foundry V33 contains a functional six-provider soundtrack hub with per-theme provider and URL persistence, real external navigation, and a truthful no-remote-playback-without-authorized-host boundary.
findings.proposal: Add a provider capability/auth matrix and exercise Spotify PKCE plus Apple MusicKit web authorization while preserving all existing navigation fallbacks.

findings.summary: Favorite Artist Worlds v4.0.1 is a verified preservation-first database line with 5 artists, 10 world variants, 20 districts, 20 weather systems, 25 interaction rules, 21 music routes, 75 discovery links and 50 provenance records; JSON/SQLite/FTS/workbook/archive integrity is documented.
findings.proposal: Run the unchanged v4.0.1 fixture/query corpus against SQLite 3.53.4 and record engine/source identity and query-plan deltas before any database migration.

findings.summary: GameSync 0.25.9 preserves a verified 0.25.8 base plus Feature Foundry theme/workspace adoption. North Star Pass 2 reports 9 tests, 568 JS syntax checks, 179 JSON checks, 689 HTML resource checks, 78 manifest resource checks, 615 no-cap runtime-file checks, 264/264 entry controls, 213/213 static actions, and 18/18 workspaces with 54 distinct actions; browser runtime remained unproven in that environment.
findings.proposal: Prototype a one-theme Design Tokens 2025.10 interchange round trip as an adapter only, preserving all richer Feature Foundry/GameSync metadata and no-cap guarantees.

findings.summary: The 0.25.9 Live Mascot Tavern line uses real Clippy/ACS, Shimeji, WebMeji and Petz engines, preserves native behavior/state features, removes fake mascot simulation, and reduces duplicate/stale bundle work by 711857 bytes (14.45%). The full archive is 247583122 bytes with SHA-256 87c4380af9e5bf405dca67c07160086a79cb2e9e3f1381cc23120ffaac7678f4. Managed Chromium runtime was blocked and is not counted as passed.
findings.proposal: Treat room integration as a capability adapter over native engines and add a deterministic cross-engine room/restart fixture rather than a replacement mascot engine.

findings.summary: Real Library Performance Pass 1 added an O(n) Steam title merge, portrait-first cover selection and complete-library telemetry while explicitly preserving no virtualization, no viewport admission and full quality. Current shipping GameSync pins @sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm ^3.53.0-build1. Live RESYNC_STEAM remains the required baseline.
findings.proposal: After the real RESYNC_STEAM baseline, compare current storage with SQLite 3.53.4 opfs/opfs-wl/opfs-sahpool candidates on the identical full library, selecting VFS by actual concurrency requirements.
